# arnaud-zg/skills

> An Agent Skills marketplace named arnaud-zg-skills, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot
> CLI and any agent that reads SKILL.md. Each skill is linted, tested and versioned. Its first plugin,
> arnaud-zg, ships the skills listed in its README.

- [Documentation home](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/docs/README.md): a map of every page

## Skills

- [arnaud-zg plugin README](https://github.com/arnaud-zg/skills/blob/main/plugins/arnaud-zg/README.md): every skill, what it does, how to call it, and links to its tutorial, how-to guides, reference, explanation and SKILL.md
- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install arnaud-zg --marketplace arnaud-zg/skills`
- Install in Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add arnaud-zg/skills`, then install arnaud-zg from `/plugins`
- Install in GitHub Copilot CLI: `copilot plugin marketplace add arnaud-zg/skills`, then `copilot plugin install arnaud-zg@arnaud-zg-skills`
- Install in Cursor: add arnaud-zg/skills as a plugin marketplace in Cursor's settings (it reads `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json`)
- Install in any other agent (Gemini CLI, OpenCode and more): `npx skills add arnaud-zg/skills --skill <name>`
